summary: Identify the actual plugin in approval prompts, redact payloads, and make cancellation terminal.
features: Resolve approval requests to the actual installed plugin name and composer plugin identity.
Summarize executable API operations as concise provider, method, and path descriptions.
Show cancelled plugin work as a distinct activity state without leaving an icon active.
Keep automatic Workshop Memory release synchronization enabled.
fixes: Remove the hard-coded GitHub label from approvals requested by Cloudflare and other plugins.
Stop displaying complete code arguments and unnecessary account identifiers in approval prompts.
Return immediately after cancellation so the model cannot ask for the same approval again.
Preserve approval requirements for tools capable of both read and write operations.
validation: Provider resolution, concise operation extraction, argument redaction, and terminal cancellation regression coverage
Cancelled activity state and plugin identity coverage
Release and Workshop Memory synchronization metadata validation
